Doses are expressed in terms of anti-factor Xa activity (anti-Xa units) although different values may be encountered in the liter- ature depending upon the reference preparation used. In the prophylaxis of venous thromboembolism during surgery, reviparin sodium is given subcutaneously in a dose of 1432 units once daily, with the first dose given 2 hours before surgery. ◊ References. 1.
